verification: Read the exact deployed source on the RTX3090 host; no extra inference calls.
decode_steps: n_gen > 0 ? n_gen - 1 : 0; the first generated token comes from the last prompt batch logits.
agent_aggregate_decode_rate: sum(predicted_per_second_i * predicted_ms_i) / sum(predicted_ms_i), only when all turns provide measurements.
generated_token_count: Keep the full API completion_tokens and native predicted_n; do not change them to decode-step counts.
prefill_time: Sum native prompt_ms; native prompt_n counts actually processed input and may exclude a reused prefix.
full_wait: Client wall time through the terminal answer, including tool turns; independent of native prefill/decode rates.
offline_correction: The intermediate inventory divided full predicted_n by decode time, differing from the pinned backend by one token per turn. Final aggregation uses the native rate; raw results and the earlier first-profile summary already using the native rate remain unchanged.
